name: cards
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an existing character 2 illustration. Image 2 is the AUTHORITATIVE ORIGINAL HAIR REFERENCE. Edit ONLY the HAIR of image 1 to faithfully restore image 2's exact hairstyle. This is a correction of an over-wide, over-layered generated bob, NOT a new character or pose. KEEP image 1's EXACT pose, facial expression, mouth shape and smile/frown, eyelid open/closed state, eyebrow emotion, gaze, face shape, head tilt/position/size, ears, neck, skin, choker, body, arms, fingers, clothes, cards (if present), lighting, rendering, canvas size and framing unchanged. Do not copy image 2's serious expression or its body pose. Use image 2 ONLY to determine hair color, silhouette, parting, locks and tips. HAIR CORRECTION: the original has a comparatively narrow, compact pale-pink chin-length bob falling DOWNWARD close to the temples/cheeks/jaw, with a smooth gently convex outside contour. Match the original hair-to-face width ratio, especially below the ears and beside the jaw; REDUCE the edit target's inflated side/back volume to that of image 2 (roughly 12-18 percent narrower in the lower sides where it currently fans out, evaluated relative to unchanged face size). Do not shrink or stretch the head or face to simulate narrower hair. The long thick fringe must still fully cover HER RIGHT EYE (viewer LEFT), with the original long downward sweep; only her LEFT eye on viewer RIGHT may be visible if open in image 1. Match image 2's ACTUAL number/thickness/separation/overlap/flow of locks across crown, bangs, temples, sides, back and ends. Remove the target's ADDED stacked outward-flaring locks, clustered curled loops and feathery lower-side fringe; these are absent from the original. Reference tips are a few restrained natural curves pointing mostly down/inward, with only the reference's small outward turns. Do not add new bundles or outward hair wings. Do not merge the reference's real fine locks into big smooth blobs; retain its meaningful boundaries, subtle strands, shading and gloss. Avoid threadlike flyaways, frizz, scribbled loops. Pale pink color stays the same. Actual transparent background, one character, no text, no frame, no UI or effects. Preserve all non-hair content and alignment precisely.
Target: the portrait with BOTH hands holding red-backed cards. Keep that exact gentle closed-mouth smile, open red eye, all cards/hands and lower body. Same 1038x1515 canvas.
